author: _Mx_
body:
Hey!

I was just thinking if anyone else thought it'd make sense to add a new feature to the site, Forum Messages. Essentially, I'm just suggesting that a new feature is added so you can message people via forums. It'd make communication much easier. Do any of you reading this agree? Just a little thought.

Side Note: I'm not sure if this is already possible.
